name: com.360dialog/mcp
title: 360dialog
description: Manage WhatsApp Business accounts on 360Dialog: channels, templates, sandbox, inbox, and more.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description:
List the 360Dialog skills available to you.

A skill is a curated, up-to-date how-to guide for a 360Dialog process (e.g. drafting a
compliant WhatsApp template, diagnosing a channel that stopped sending). Call this tool
BEFORE answering any "how do I..." question about 360Dialog products or processes -
it tells you which skills exist and when to use them. Once you find a match, call
'get_skill' with its 'name' to read the full guide.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get the full guide for one skill returned by 'list_skills', as markdown.

name.description: A skill's 'name' field, as returned by list_skills.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description:
Returns the URL where a user can create a 360Dialog account. Only relevant if the user has not
created a 360Dialog account yet.

tools.name: search_client_documentation
tools.description: Search the 360Dialog client documentation at https://docs.360dialog.com/docs. Search across the documentation to find relevant information, code examples, API references, and guides. Use this tool when you need to answer questions about Client Documentation, find specific documentation, understand how features work, or locate implementation details. The search returns contextual content with titles and direct links to the documentation pages.

tools.name: get_client_documentation_page
tools.description: Get a documentation page from the 360Dialog client documentation at https://docs.360dialog.com/docs. Fetch the full markdown content of a specific documentation page from Client Documentation. Use this when you have a page URL and want to read its content. Accepts full URLs (e.g. https://docs.360dialog.com/docs/getting-started). Since `searchDocumentation` returns partial content, use `getPage` to retrieve the complete page when you need more details. The content includes links you can follow to navigate to related pages.

url.description: The URL of the page to fetch

tools.name: get_messaging_analytics
tools.description:
Show messages sent, delivered and billed for a phone number (channel) over a date range, and their cost.

Without dates it covers the last 7 days; ranges over 90 days are summarised by month. Days follow the WhatsApp Business Account's timezone, and today (or this month) appears only once it's over. Rate limited, so prefer one call covering the whole range.

start_date.description: First day to include, as an ISO date like 2026-05-01. Defaults to 6 days before the end date, so the last 7 days when no dates are given.

end_date.description: Last day to include, as an ISO date like 2026-05-07. Defaults to today.

granularity.description: Report by day or by calendar month. Defaults to daily; ranges over 90 days are always monthly.

tools.name: get_voice_analytics
tools.description:
Show the number, duration and cost of calls for a phone number (channel) over a date range.

Without dates it covers the last 7 days; ranges over 90 days are summarised by month. Days follow the WhatsApp Business Account's timezone, and today (or this month) appears only once it's over. Rate limited, so prefer one call covering the whole range.

start_date.description: First day to include, as an ISO date like 2026-05-01. Defaults to 6 days before the end date, so the last 7 days when no dates are given.

end_date.description: Last day to include, as an ISO date like 2026-05-07. Defaults to today.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description:
Find a channel by passing in an identifier.

A channel is a phone number. By calling this tool you retrieve information about the phone number/channel in 360Dialog.

Results are paginated; use the 'page' and 'size' arguments to page through results if there are more than fit in a single page.

Returns:
    If no channel matches, returns "No channels found." If found, returns information of channels, like WABA ID, client ID, channel ID, app ID and the number's 360Dialog Hub page, along with the current page, total pages, and total count.

filter.description: Optional filter. You can pass a phone number, client ID, or channel ID here. Defaults to None; call without this argument if you want to get all channels.

page.description: Page number to retrieve, starting at 1.

size.description: Number of channels to return per page, at most 100.

tools.name: set_display_name
tools.description:
Submit a new display name for this channel (a.k.a. phone number.)

Calling this tool will submit a display name request to Meta. Meta takes up to 48 hours to review the submitted display name. The display name may be rejected if it does not comply with display name guidelines.

The user will receive an email when their display name review is complete.

When this tool is called, the user may be prompted by 360Dialog for an OTP code delivered to their email address.

new_display_name.description: New requested display name for this phone number.

tools.name: get_channel_profile
tools.description: Get a channel's (a.k.a. phone number) WhatsApp profile, and the profile's 360Dialog Hub page.

tools.name: update_channel_profile
tools.description:
Update the WhatsApp profile for this channel (a.k.a. phone number.)

The user may be prompted by 360Dialog for an OTP code delivered to their email address. Make them aware of the OTP requirement.

about_text.description: About text. Set to a string to update; set to null to clear; omit to leave unchanged.

full_address.description: Full address. Set to a string to update; set to null to clear; omit to leave unchanged.

business_description.description: Business description. Set to a string to update; set to null to clear; omit to leave unchanged.

contact_email.description: Contact email. Set to a string to update; set to null to clear; omit to leave unchanged.

business_vertical.description: Set to a vertical to update; set to null to clear; omit to leave unchanged.

websites.description: Websites. Set to a list to update; set to null to clear; omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: get_channel_details
tools.description:
Show the full details of one channel: status, availability, quality rating,
messaging limit, registration code status, and its WABA, project, client and app IDs.

Also shows the channel's WhatsApp Business Account (WABA): its status, Meta business verification status,
message-on-behalf status, phone number and conversation limits, Meta ban state, and any policy violations
affecting this number. Use it to troubleshoot restricted or unverified accounts.

Useful for when the user asks more details for a specific number. Use 'list_channels' to find channels first.

tools.name: get_business_username_suggestions
tools.description:
Suggest available WhatsApp business usernames for a channel.

Meta reserves these usernames for the number's business. Use this before 'set_business_username'.

tools.name: set_business_username
tools.description:
Claim or change the WhatsApp business username of a channel.

This changes what WhatsApp users see for the business, because the username can be shown instead of the phone number.
Meta may reject the username, in which case an error is returned.

username.description: The username to claim for this number. Use 'get_business_username_suggestions' to see usernames reserved for it.

force_transfer.description: Set to true only if the username is currently on another number of the same business portfolio and should move to this one. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_commerce_settings
tools.description: Show whether the WhatsApp Business catalog is visible and the cart is enabled on a channel.

tools.name: update_commerce_settings
tools.description:
Turn the catalog visibility and the cart on or off for a channel.

This changes what WhatsApp users see in the chat with the business. Pass at least one of 'catalog_visible' and
'cart_enabled'; a value that is left out keeps its current setting.

catalog_visible.description: Whether the catalog is visible to WhatsApp users. Omit to leave unchanged.

cart_enabled.description: Whether the cart is enabled for WhatsApp users. Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: enable_local_storage
tools.description:
Store a channel's message data in a chosen region.

The channel is re-registered in Cloud API after calling this tool. Contact our support team
if this tool fails.

data_localization_region.description: Region code where this number's message data is at rest.

tools.name: list_blocked_users
tools.description:
Show which WhatsApp users are blocked from messaging a channel.

Meta always returns the BSUID; phone number is only returned when it has been shared with the business.
To unblock a user without a phone number, pass their BSUID to 'unblock_users' in 'user_ids'.

tools.name: block_users
tools.description:
Block WhatsApp users from messaging a channel.

Identify each user by phone number or by BSUID; pass at least one of 'phone_numbers' and 'user_ids'.

Only a business can block users who recently messaged it, so some users can fail. The result lists which succeeded and which failed with the reason.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers of the WhatsApp users to block, in international format without '+' or spaces, for example ['49100100200'].

user_ids.description: Business-scoped user IDs (BSUIDs) of the WhatsApp users to block, for users whose phone number isn't known. 'list_blocked_users' shows each blocked user's BSUID.

tools.name: unblock_users
tools.description:
Unblock WhatsApp users so they can message a channel again.

Identify each user by phone number or by BSUID; pass at least one of 'phone_numbers' and 'user_ids'.
For a user that 'list_blocked_users' shows without a phone number, pass the BSUID in 'user_ids'.

The result lists which users were unblocked and which failed with the reason.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers of the WhatsApp users to unblock, in international format without '+' or spaces, for example ['49100100200'].

user_ids.description: Business-scoped user IDs (BSUIDs) of the WhatsApp users to unblock, for users whose phone number isn't known. 'list_blocked_users' shows each blocked user's BSUID.

tools.name: get_currency_migration_status
tools.description:
Show the progress of a WABA's billing currency change.

Returns the most recent migration, or says there is none.

tools.name: wait_for_onboarding_step
tools.description:
Wait for a server-side onboarding step to finish, then report back.

Embedded Signup and payment setup finish in the person's browser. This tool
polls the hub every 5 seconds for up to 45 seconds and returns one of:

- "done": The step finished.
- "pending": Still not finished. Call this tool again to keep waiting.
- "failed": There was an error.

'channel_id' and 'phone_number' are returned back once a channel is found so you can pass
'phone_number' into the next call once you have it. When 'phone_number' is omitted, 'candidates'
lists the client's most recently created channels - check it if you're unsure the right number
was picked (e.g. two users connecting numbers on the same 360Dialog client account).

Only use this for the short waits during onboarding. This tool is NOT suitable for display name
approval, WABA approval, or business verification scenarios, as they take days, not seconds.

step.description: Which step to wait for: 'number_connected' (a new phone number was added), 'payment_connected' (the client has a payment method), or 'channel_live' (the number is ready to send messages).

phone_number.description: The phone number to wait for - optional. If absent for 'number_connected' and 'channel_live', reports back with top 3 recently connected/went live phone numbers. If present, it checks the status for the specific phone number. Not relevant for 'payment_connected'.

tools.name: get_company_details
tools.description: Get the user's company's details from 360Dialog.

tools.name: update_company_details
tools.description:
Set the user's company's details on 360Dialog. This change does not affect Meta; only records on
360Dialog are affected by the update.

Before calling this tool, make sure to:

1. Check if the `get_company_details` tool returns the correct company information already.
2. Check with the user if they want to change their company details in 360Dialog.
3. Get the user's approval/confirmation.

tools.name: check_number_eligibility
tools.description:
Check whether a phone number can be onboarded for this client before handing over the onboarding link.

This tool only checks 360Dialog's own database and this client's channel quota. It does not ask
WhatsApp/Meta anything, so a number already active on WhatsApp elsewhere (including the personal
app) can still come back eligible here.

check_coex.description: Set to true if the phone number to check is currently on the WhatsApp Business app (not to be confused with the normal, personal, WhatsApp app.) WhatsApp Business app numbers can be onboarded to the API as well using WhatsApp Coexistence

tools.name: start_number_onboarding
tools.description:
Get the link that lets the user connect a WhatsApp phone number in 360Dialog, plus what to tell them beforehand.

This hands over 360Dialog's own onboarding page. The user clicks
through Embedded Signup themselves; this tool cannot do it for them.

The user must be signed in to 360Dialog Hub already, or the link sends them to login first and loses
the destination. Tell them to make sure they're signed in first.

The link given by this tool may not work if the user's 360Dialog client account
is under a partner-paid channel. Make them aware of this.

Returns the client's current channel IDs for future reference on recognizing
which phone number was newly added.

tools.name: get_onboarding_status
tools.description:
Get a phone number's status on whether a number is live, what type of messages it can send today,
and suggestions for what's next.

A live number can send free-form replies inside the 24-hour customer service window immediately
(meaning if someone messages the number, the user can respond to the message using the API).
Template messages are separately blocked until Meta reviews a submitted template (template reviews
take up to 24 hours.)

Lack of business verification is not a blocker. Unverified businesses can only send 250 templates
to unique users per 24 hours.

phone_number.description: The phone number of the number being onboarded

tools.name: request_otp
tools.description:
Request an OTP code.

Sometimes OTP is needed to complete invoking a tool. When tool invocation fails due to OTP reasons, you will be
notified in the tool response, and be asked to rqeuest an OTP code.

Only call after a tool call fails due to OTP. In clients that show apps, the user enters the code in a card
shown with the result, and the result says so.

tools.name: verify_otp
tools.description:
Verify the 6-digit OTP code from the user. Doing so will automatically replay the blocked tool call that required
verification, except for tools whose result is shown to the user in an app: for those, the result says to call
the tool again.

code.description: 6-digit OTP code. You must receive this from the user.

tools.name: get_platform_status
tools.description:
Check whether 360Dialog or WhatsApp currently has an outage or degraded service.

Use this first when messages fail, webhooks stop, or the user asks whether the platform is down.

tools.name: list_platform_status_subscriptions
tools.description: List the user's 360Dialog status update subscriptions (delivered via email).

tools.name: subscribe_platform_status_updates
tools.description: Subscribe the user to 360Dialog status update emails.

tools.name: unsubscribe_platform_status_updates
tools.description: Stop 360Dialog status update emails for the user.

subscriber_id.description: Use 'list_platform_status_subscriptions' to find a subscription's ID.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List templates for a WABA (WhatsApp Business Account). If you do not have a waba_account_id ending in 'WA' (case-insensitive), run the 'list_channels' tool first.

name_filter.description: Template name to search for. If one is not provided, leave blank.

status_filter.description: Filter templates by status. Allowed values are 'approved', 'pending', 'paused', 'rejected'. Leave blank if not needed.

tools.name: show_template_preview
tools.description: Show a preview of a given template to the user.

template_id.description: Needs to end with 'WT'. Use 'list_templates' to find a template's ID.

tools.name: get_template_json_example
tools.description:
Sending messaging templates in WhatsApp API / 360Dialog API requires a JSON body in the API request.

The API request can be hard to form, as the body must declare in JSON what each parameter in the JSON should
be filled as.

This tool creates a valid example JSON body that the user can later modify before sending the template to WhatsApp users.

It is recommended that you use this tool after creating a template, or after the user asks how to send a template.
Display the JSON result of this tool.

template_id.description: Needs to end with 'WT'. Use 'list_templates' to find a template's ID.

tools.name: create_template
delete_template
tools.description: Delete a WhatsApp message template by its internal template ID.

template_id.description: Needs to end with 'WT'. Use 'list_templates' to find a template's ID.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description:
Get a channel's (a.k.a. phone number's) webhook URL, and check if the optional webhook headers are set.

Webhook headers are optional. They can be set using the 'set_webhook' tool, which also sets the webhook URL.
When webhook headers are set, 360Dialog will send webhooks to the channel's webhook URL and add the specified headers.

This helps only authenticated requests pass through app firewalls, if the user has any.

Example:

If webhook URL is `https://foo.com/webhook`, and webhook headers are set to {"x-360dialog-webhook-security": "RANDOM-STRING"},
the webhook URL will receive POST requests like this:

POST https://foo.com/webhook
HEADERS
    x-360dialog-webhook-security: RANDOM-STRING

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Set a channel's (a.k.a. phone number's) webhook URL and optionally webhook headers.

tools.name: send_test_webhook_event
tools.description:
Send sample events to a channel's (a.k.a. phone number's) or a WABA's webhook, so the user can
check that the webhook receives them and answers with a 2xx code.

Pass exactly one of 'channel_id' or 'waba_account_id'. The user may see several sample requests arrive at
their webhook server. Returns which sample events passed and which failed.

channel_id.description: Channel ID, ending in 'CH', to test that channel's webhook. Leave blank when testing a WABA.

waba_account_id.description: WABA ID, ending in 'WA', to test the WABA's webhook. Leave blank when testing a channel.

tools.name: get_self
tools.description:
Get currently logged in user's information in 360Dialog. You will get:
- user's name,
- user's email address,
- partner name,
- user's permissions in 360Dialog Hub,
- user's roles

tools.name: list_users
tools.description:
List users of the selected account, including their roles and creation timestamps.

Client users get the users of their own client account, partner users the users of the partner account.

tools.name: invite_user
tools.description:
Invite a new user to the account, with a role. The invitee gets an email with a link to set their password.

Client users invite to their own client account, partner users to the partner account. To create a new client
together with its first user, use 'create_client_and_invite'.

The user may be prompted by 360Dialog for an OTP code delivered to their email address.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite.

name.description: Full name of the person to invite.

role.description: Role to give the new user. 'partner-owner' or 'partner-member' on a partner account, 'client-owner' or 'client-member' on a client account. Owners can invite users and manage the account; members can use it but not manage users.

tools.name: change_user_role
tools.description:
Change the role of an existing user of the account. Users cannot change their own role.

Client users change users of their own client account, partner users users of the partner account.

The user may be prompted by 360Dialog for an OTP code delivered to their email address.

role.description: New role. 'partner-owner' or 'partner-member' on a partner account, 'client-owner' or 'client-member' on a client account.

user_id.description: Needs to end with 'U'. Use 'list_users' to find a user's ID.

tools.name: sandbox_register_number
tools.description:
Register the user's phone number on the 360Dialog sandbox. Upon registration, the user can send messages to this phone number from the 360Dialog sandbox account on WhatsApp.

The user will be given a link to complete registration. When this link is used, they will send a verification code to 360Dialog sandbox phone number on WhatsApp. They can click the link, or alternatively scan the QR code.

tools.name: sandbox_complete_registration
tools.description: Complete a phone number's registration. This will get you the API key to use when sending messages from the 360Dialog sandbox phone number to the user's registered phone number.

tools.name: sandbox_send_message

payload.description: JSON body of the WhatsApp message to send. Use a text payload only inside an active 24-hour customer service window; use a template payload to start or continue conversations outside that window.

tools.name: sandbox_configure_webhook
tools.description: Set webhook for the channel on 360Dialog sandbox. Optional.

url.description: Webhook to set for this channel on sandbox

tools.name: sandbox_get_webhook_configuration
tools.description: Get configured webhook for the channel on 360Dialog sandbox.

tools.name: sandbox_list_events
tools.description:
List webhook events received. This will show received messages from the user, and status of messages
sent from the sandbox account.

page.description: Page number. Starts from 1, defaults to 1.

tools.name: get_client_details
tools.description:
Show one client's account details and status: name, status, number limit, contact information and Meta
business ID.

Client users see their own account. Partner users pass the ID of one of their clients.

tools.name: list_partner_change_requests
tools.description:
List requests to move numbers between partners, with their status.

Client users see the requests their client made. Partner users see the requests addressed to their partner,
which they can approve or reject; a partner can pass 'client_id' to only see the requests of one client.
Pass 'request_id' to follow the status of one request.

request_id.description: Optional. Only show the request with this ID.

status.description: Optional. Only list requests in this status. 'created' means waiting for the new partner's approval.

page.description: Page number to retrieve, starting at 1.

size.description: Number of requests to return per page, at most 100.

tools.name: preview_partner_change_request
tools.description:
Check whether numbers can move to a new partner, without creating a request. Runs the same pre-flight checks
as 'create_partner_change_request' and reports every issue that would block the move (for example a number
that cannot move, a missing company detail, or a request that is already in progress).

Nothing is created or changed. Show the result to the user, then, if it is clear, call
'create_partner_change_request' with the same arguments.

target_partner_id.description: ID of the partner the numbers should move to. Needs to end with 'PA'.

channel_ids.description: IDs of the numbers (channels) to move. Use 'list_channels' to find them. All numbers of a WABA have to move together.

target_client_id.description: Optional. ID of an existing client at the new partner to move the numbers into. Only for a partial move (not all numbers of the client). Needs to end with 'CL'.

items.description: Which payment plan (bundle) of the new partner a number moves onto. Needed when the new partner bills clients.

bundle_id.description: ID of the new partner's payment plan for this number.

channel_bundles.description: Optional. Which payment plan of the new partner each number moves onto. Only needed when the new partner bills its clients.

tools.name: create_partner_change_request
tools.description:
Request that the client's numbers move to a new partner. The new partner has to approve the request; then the
numbers are moved, which changes who manages them and who is billed.

ALWAYS call 'preview_partner_change_request' first with the same arguments, show its result to the user and
get their confirmation before calling this tool. This tool also runs the preview itself and does NOT create the
request when the preview finds issues; it then returns the issues instead.

The user may be prompted by 360Dialog for an OTP code delivered to their email address.

target_partner_id.description: ID of the partner the numbers should move to. Needs to end with 'PA'.

channel_ids.description: IDs of the numbers (channels) to move. Use 'list_channels' to find them. All numbers of a WABA have to move together.

target_client_id.description: Optional. ID of an existing client at the new partner to move the numbers into. Only for a partial move (not all numbers of the client). Needs to end with 'CL'.

items.description: Which payment plan (bundle) of the new partner a number moves onto. Needed when the new partner bills clients.

bundle_id.description: ID of the new partner's payment plan for this number.

channel_bundles.description: Optional. Which payment plan of the new partner each number moves onto. Only needed when the new partner bills its clients.

tools.name: inbox_send_message
tools.description:
Send a message into an existing conversation, as the business.

This is inbox-scoped sending: it posts into an existing conversation with
correct threading. Outside the 24-hour customer-care window, WhatsApp only
permits template messages — other types are rejected with an explanation.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

content.description: The type-specific message object, following the WhatsApp Business API shape. For type=text: {"body": "..."}. For image/video: {"link": "https://...", "caption"?}. For document: {"link": "https://...", "filename"?, "caption"?}. For audio/sticker: {"link": "..."}. For template: {"name": "...", "language": {...}, "components": [...]}. For interactive/location/contacts: the corresponding WABA object.

tools.name: inbox_assign_conversation
tools.description:
Assign or reassign one conversation to an agent and/or a group.

Both fields are always set to exactly what you pass: calling with only
`user_id` clears any group assignment and vice versa; calling with neither
unassigns the conversation entirely.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

user_id.description: Agent (user) ID from list_agents to assign; omit/null to leave unassigned.

group_id.description: Group ID from list_groups to assign; omit/null to leave unassigned.

tools.name: inbox_tag_conversation
tools.description: Add or remove one tag on one conversation.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

action.description: Add the tag to or remove it from the conversation.

tools.name: inbox_mark_conversation_as_read
tools.description:
Mark one conversation's messages as read by the calling user.

Pass `up_to_timestamp` after reviewing a conversation so that messages
arriving in the meantime stay unread. The read mark only moves forward: a
timestamp older than the caller's current mark changes nothing. Read state
is per inbox user: this clears the unread count for the caller only, not
for other agents. The inbox also marks the messages as read on WhatsApp,
so the contact sees read receipts. Only conversations whose messages you
can read can be marked.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

up_to_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the last message you reviewed, taken from get_conversation results; messages up to and including it are marked read, newer ones stay unread. Omit to mark everything currently in the conversation.

tools.name: inbox_apply_saved_response
tools.description:
Send a saved (canned) response into a conversation as a text message.

Subject to the same 24-hour window rule as inbox_send_message.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

tools.name: inbox_list_conversations
tools.description:
List conversations of the inbox, newest activity first.

Returns one entry per conversation with contact info, unread count, last
message, current assignee (user and/or group), and tags.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

assigned_to_me.description: Only conversations assigned to the calling user.

unread.description: Only conversations with unread incoming messages.

tag_id.description: Only conversations carrying this tag (see list_tags).

tools.name: inbox_search_conversations
tools.description:
Find conversations by contact name, phone number, tag name, or message content.

Searches contact profiles and tags first, then message text and media
captions; results from both are merged and deduplicated by conversation.
Each match notes why it matched (`contact` or `message_content`).

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

tools.name: inbox_get_conversation
tools.description:
Read one conversation: contact/assignment/tag details plus its message history.

Messages are returned newest first. To page further back, call again with
`before_time` set to the oldest returned message's timestamp.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

before_time.description: Only messages strictly older than this POSIX timestamp — use for paging back through history.

since_time.description: Only messages at or after this POSIX timestamp.

tools.name: inbox_list_inboxes
tools.description:
List the WhatsApp inboxes the calling 360dialog user can access.

Call this first when you don't know which `channel_id` to pass to the

tools.name: mba_run_connector_tool
tools.description: Execute one connector tool once, as the agent would, and return what the third-party system answered. Use it to check a definition works before relying on it. `input` is a JSON-ENCODED STRING of the arguments, not an object. Known limitation: the result is DOUBLY STRINGIFIED - the response is {output, status} where `output` is a JSON string; parse `output`, then parse its `.body` to reach the third-party system's actual response. What this call does depends entirely on the tool being run: it can create, change or delete data in the connected system.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

input.description: Arguments as a JSON-encoded string, e.g. '{"order_id":"123"}'. Defaults to an empty object.

tools.name: mba_send_agent_event
tools.description: Trigger the agent to act on a consumer conversation asynchronously - the event is queued and the call returns immediately with status "accepted" and an agent_event_id. Poll mba_get_agent_event with that id to find out what happened; a 202-style acknowledgement here does not mean the consumer was messaged. Known limitation: event.payload must be a JSON-ESCAPED STRING, not an object - pass "{\"order_id\":\"123\"}", not {"order_id": "123"}. Maximum 4096 characters.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

to.description: Consumer's WhatsApp number in E.164 format.

description.description: What happened, in words the agent can act on (max 1024 characters).

payload.description: Opaque JSON-ENCODED STRING passed to the agent as-is (max 4096 characters).

tools.name: mba_get_agent_event
tools.description: Read the processing status of an event submitted with mba_send_agent_event. Status is one of request_received, processing, sent, failed, skipped or success; failed and skipped carry error_message and skipped_reason. This is the only way to find out whether an accepted event actually reached the consumer.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

tools.name: mba_test_agent
tools.description: Send a test message through the full agent pipeline and read its reply, without needing a real consumer number. Pass conversation_id from a previous reply to continue the same test conversation. Known limitation: while ai_audience is ALLOWLISTED_ONLY this returns agent_response: "" with no_response_reason: "ELIGIBILITY_CHECK_FAILED", no matter which consumer number is involved - check mba_get_agent_settings before concluding the agent is broken.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

user_msg.description: The message to send to the agent.

conversation_id.description: Optional - continue an existing test conversation.

tools.name: mba_release_thread_control
tools.description: Hand a consumer conversation back to the Meta Business Agent as the automatic responder, after a human agent has taken it over. Only releasing is supported here - taking control is restricted to configured escalation partners.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

to.description: Consumer's WhatsApp number in E.164 format.

tools.name: mba_send_message
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp message to a consumer and release thread control back to the agent. The body is the WhatsApp Cloud API message object - set `type` and the matching payload key (text, template, interactive, image, ...). This messages a real person: it is subject to the platform's send eligibility rules, and outside a 24-hour customer service window only an approved template will be delivered.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

to.description: Consumer's WhatsApp number in E.164 format.

type.description: Message type, e.g. text, template, interactive, image.

text.description: Used when type is text, e.g. {"body": "Hello"}.

tools.name: mba_list_eval_cases
tools.description: List the evaluation scenarios configured for this agent, each with its scenario text, categories, max_turns and success criteria. Their ids are what mba_start_eval_run takes.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

tools.name: mba_start_eval_run
tools.description: Submit an evaluation job that simulates the listed cases against the agent, evaluates the conversations and optionally produces insights. Returns {job_id, status: QUEUED} - the work is asynchronous, so poll mba_get_eval_results with the job_id. Known limitation: eval_case_ids is read from the QUERY STRING, not the request body - pass it as the comma-separated argument here and this service puts it in the right place; the body is a separate object that accepts nothing else.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

eval_case_ids.description: Comma-separated eval case ids from list_eval_cases.

tools.name: mba_get_eval_results
tools.description: Read an evaluation job by its job_id. While the job runs this gives the status (QUEUED or RUNNING) and the progress. When the job fails it gives the error. When the job completes it gives the aggregated report: the summary text, the average conversation and turn scores, the highlights and the top failure categories. There is no separate summary call: a completed job already carries that report. For the per-conversation transcripts and per-turn labels, take the ids from `eval_ids_by_score` and call mba_get_eval_details. This tool adds a `details` key when it can read those ids for you.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

tools.name: mba_get_eval_details
tools.description: Read per-conversation evaluation results - scores, per-turn labels, reasons and the transcript. Takes eval_ids, which is a different kind of id from the job_id that mba_get_eval_results takes. Read them from the eval_ids_by_score field of a completed job. mba_get_eval_results already adds these details when it can read that field, so call this tool when it could not.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

tools.name: mba_get_agent_event_insights
tools.description: Read what happened to the events sent to the agent (mba_send_agent_event) over a date range, one row per event type, busiest first: how many were received, how many the agent successfully processed, and the mean end-to-end latency. Successfully processed means the agent sent its message, not that the message was delivered. Figures are rolled up once a day, so the most recent day may still be incomplete. Known limitation: the dates are in PACIFIC TIME, not the business time zone, and the range may span at most 30 days, counting both ends.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

start_date.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time. Inclusive.

end_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time. Inclusive.

event_type.description: Return only this event type, named as it was sent. Omit for every event type.

tools.name: mba_get_conversation_turns
tools.description: Read the ordered turns of the most recent conversation between the agent and one customer. Each turn carries its turn_id, conversation_id and the observed steps - LLM calls with a preview of the model output, and tool calls with the tool name, input and output - plus latency and status where available. Use it to see why the agent answered the way it did. Malformed records, and tool responses that cannot be matched to a tool call, may be missing. This list is CURSOR-PAGINATED: it returns {data, paging} - page with the `after` cursor from paging.cursors, and stop when paging carries no `next` link, because a page can be empty and still have more after it.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

user_phone_number.description: The customer: a phone number in digits only with the country code (15551234567, no + or separators), a Business-Scoped User ID such as US.2788620304833812, or the conversation_id returned by test_agent. Prefer the BSUID for a customer who has ever used a WhatsApp username - their phone number may be unknown, which returns Consumer not found.

start_timestamp_ms.description: Only turns that started at or after this Unix time in milliseconds.

end_timestamp_ms.description: Only turns that started at or before this Unix time in milliseconds.

before.description: Cursor - return the page immediately before it.

after.description: Cursor - return the page immediately after it.

limit.description: Maximum entries per page. A page can be shorter.

tools.name: mba_get_conversation_insights
tools.description: Read how many conversations the agent replied in over a date range (ai_threads), and how many are currently handed from the agent to the business and still awaiting a business reply (ai_handoffs). Counts are per conversation, not per message, and match the business's own agent summaries. Returns {data: [one row]}, each metric as {count}, present only when requested. Known limitation: ai_handoffs is a SNAPSHOT of the present moment - it ignores start_date and end_date. The range may span at most 90 days, counting both ends, and each requested metric costs a separate scan, so ask only for what you need.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

start_date.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

end_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

metrics.description: Which metrics to return. Omit for all of them.

tools.name: mba_get_tool_call_insights
tools.description: Read how each of the business's own tools performed over a date range, one row per tool, busiest first: how many conversations called it, its mean latency, and its success, error and timeout rates (0 to 1; timeouts count as errors too). Only tools the business supplied are reported. thread_count counts a conversation once per day, so one that called the tool on three days counts three times. Figures are rolled up once a day, so the most recent day may still be incomplete. Known limitation: the range may span at most 30 days, counting both ends.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

start_date.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

end_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone. Inclusive.

tool_name.description: Return only this tool, named as it was registered. Omit for every tool called.

tools.name: mba_get_agent_usage_insights
tools.description: Read the billed usage of a Meta Business Agent account over a billing date range, one entry per HOUR, DAY or MONTH bucket: billable messages, billable tokens, and cost in the account's currency. Returns {usage}; an empty array means no usage in the range. Each entry carries its bucket start and end (Unix seconds, end exclusive), plus channel and sender_id when they are in dimensions. Metrics left out of metric_types are omitted from every entry, not returned as null. Tokens are BILLED tokens, the figure on the invoice, which can be fewer than the tokens the agent consumed. Known limitations: usage insights are ONLY AVAILABLE for numbers whose stack uses its own WABA access token; for any other number this tool returns an error that says so. The range is start INCLUSIVE, end EXCLUSIVE, and dates are evaluated in the billable account's timezone, so a day bucket can be 23 or 25 hours long. MONTH needs a range of whole months: start on the 1st, end on the last day of a month.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

billable_account_id.description: The billable account ID of the Meta Business Agent account. No other tool returns it: Meta Billing Hub shows it under Accounts > Meta Business Agent accounts. It is not the Business Manager ID the budget tools take.

start.description: Start of the range, Unix seconds. Inclusive: buckets that start at or after it.

end.description: End of the range, Unix seconds. Exclusive: buckets that start before it.

dimensions.description: Split each bucket by these axes. Omit to total the whole agent per bucket.

channels.description: Only usage on these messaging surfaces.

sender_ids.description: Only usage attributed to these sending entities.

metric_types.description: Which metrics to return. Omit for all of them.

tools.name: mba_get_agent_state
tools.description: Read whether this channel has ever been onboarded and whether its agent has ever been activated, as {onboarded, activated_once}. Known limitation: this is NOT a Meta call - it reads this service's own tracking record, written when onboarding or a settings read/write goes through here. It answers 'did onboarding ever succeed' and 'was rollout ever enabled', and nothing about the agent's current configuration. For live state call mba_get_agent_settings.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.
